name: MiniTop
desc: Tasks and maintenance: running programs, startup, storage
facts: Protects Onion's own processes from being ended.
Deletes files on the card only after asking, and never Onion's files, whole app folders or key files.
system: Adds a boot script (.tmp_update/startup/clocksync.sh) that sets the clock from HTTPS servers after Wi-Fi is up. Turn it off in MiniTop > Startup.
